description: [goal] Append a decision and its reason to the goal's log, optionally with a measured metric value and a new agenda for the passes after this one.

agenda.description: Hand-off to the passes after this one: what each of the next few passes does, what you expect to see by then, what you do if it does not show. Replaces the previous agenda; leave it out to keep that one. At most 1500 characters: shorten, do not split.

metric.description: Measured value of the goal's metric, if there is one now.

name: goal_note
